definitions.orders: primary settled-slice count: positive native book allocations plus retained unknown ownership; known zero allocations counted separately in zeroAllocatedOrders and all virtual closes retained under virtual
definitions.pf: primary: positive net order returns ÷ absolute negative net order returns on the same funded settled-order sample, after modeled costs; recorded Block/coordination execution multiples removed, ladder/tape leg semantics retained; see evidence.returns for source completeness
definitions.cashPf: separate reconciliation diagnostic: gross profit $ ÷ gross loss $ after sizing on the same closed-order sample; unequal sizes can change it without changing return PF
definitions.net: Σ r × unit of the closed orders, $ (r already holds the 0.2 % round-trip cost, the Block multiple and the DCA legs)
definitions.ddt: drawdown time, h: the longest time the closed-order curve stayed below a previous peak (an unrecovered one counts to the end of the window)
definitions.ddr: drawdown ratio: the closed-order curve's max drawdown ÷ its net ($); – when net ≤ 0
definitions.maxDdPct: group: max drawdown of its own closed curve ÷ (start balance + curve peak); total: the equity curve (open orders marked to market every minute)
definitions.ddNow: equity drawdown time at the end of the hour: hours since the minute equity last stood at its peak
definitions.positions: native virtual-book symbol × direction episodes (preserved separately from funded settled-slice counts): overlapping orders on one symbol and side form one position (per group: episodes of that group's orders)
definitions.greenHours: hours whose closed orders netted > 0 (of the hours with closes)
definitions.hourBucket: an order belongs to the hour of its close (h, h + 1 h]; opened = entries in [h, h + 1 h)
definitions.subType: Plain = executed at ×1; Block Active = raised by Block at level ≥ 2 (with Block Active on every executed entry must be raised)
definitions.margin: Σ unit × volume ÷ leverage of the open orders
definitions.mtm: open orders marked at the last 1m close (price at minute t = close of the bar that opened at t − 1 min), less the round-trip cost; a DCA order is marked with its full final volume from its entry
definitions.virtualPf: separate diagnostic: all virtual modeled closes before book allocation; known zero allocations excluded from funded primary PF
definitions.unitPf: the same funded settled closes with recorded Block/coordination execution multiples removed; ladder/tape leg semantics retained; independent of book sizing
definitions.variantEffect: walk-forward variants (one switch flipped against the options as run, on the same tapes): changes results = a different order set; changes volume = the same orders at other volumes / results; no effect = the identical trade set; n/a = the switch has nothing to act on; needs a recompute = it shapes the tapes when they are built. Primary PF uses recorded unit gross returns; net/marks/curves keep volume-weighted stored r × 100. Legacy primary PF is unavailable without recorded unit gross sums
definitions.sizingReplay: the live control's sizing replayed on the baseline's positions every 5 minutes, equity = the report's balance curve: top configs → per-position cap and exchange minimum → exposure scaler → stop-risk budget → worst-case budget → exchange orders against the held book (rebalance threshold). Sizing only: no fills, slippage or control stops
